issue_request: FHIR-16734 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core vocab change request asking to replace the ambiguous CodeSystem.versionNeeded wording that the code system "has not (or does not) maintain the definitions" with wording that it "does not commit to concept permanence across versions".
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies svn revision 14723. In the git mirror, commit 05faea91601a9fc2086f8bd5e71f31b4bf55a055 has subject "GF#16734 - clarify definition" and changes source/codesystem/codesystem-spreadsheet.xml from the old ambiguous wording to the proposed concept-permanence wording. Later source rework moved the authoritative definition into source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml while preserving the wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists codesystem=CodeSystem and identifies CodeSystem as a conformance/normative resource, so the inspected structure definition is in current build scope. source/codesystem/codesystem.svg still has the old tooltip text, but it is a generated-looking diagram artifact; the reconciliation rules advise against source-changing commits whose only target is such a diagram when the authoritative XML is correct. FHIR-18613 is a same-change-family CodeSystem.versionNeeded audit already represented on the combined branch and does not conflict with this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative CodeSystem.versionNeeded definition already says that the code system does not commit to concept permanence across versions and keeps the required version-reference sentence.
